caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular lantern composed of vertical wooden frame pieces and side panels that appear to be made of clear glass. The wood is depicted in shades of light brown to gray with some visible grain texture, and the four corners of the lantern extend slightly above and below the top and bottom panels. The top features a flat wooden piece with a black or dark gray semicircular metal handle attached by a central arching metal component. Inside the lantern, centered at the base, is a small metal oil lamp or burner with a horizontal handle on its side, rendered in gray tones. The lamp is set between the glass panels, and the composition is presented on a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or elements visible.
title: Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
